note: Set A and Set B contain the same 17 claims with identical values, conditions and quotes; only the ordering of two trailing-edge claims differs. Both correctly capture the spar cap (pultruded carbon unidirectional), outer skin (triaxial), trailing edge reinforcement (unidirectional glass), shear web sandwich construction, the ~50% span aft shear web and the edgewise uniaxial glass. Both also share the same defects: three 'thickness = shading colour' claims that turn a figure legend into a value, and two blade-length claims (135 m and 130 m) whose quotes are only axis labels/tick marks and do not support the values.
remarks: The two sets are content-identical, so the comparison is a tie. Shared issues: 'thickness | green/blue shading' claims misbind a legend colour to a thickness value (3 per set); 'blade length 135 m' is supported only by the axis label 'Z-coordinate [m]' and 'length 130 m' reads an axis tick (130) as a length — the two length claims also contradict each other. Material facts are duplicated three times for spar caps and twice for trailing edge reinforcement under slightly different entity names. Both sets omit the modal-frequency fact (Table 6, first 10 frequencies at standstill) and the BECAS/HAWCStab2/BeamDyn modelling facts, though those may belong to other claim categories.
